caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a comb with a rectangular upper section and eight long, evenly spaced tines extending downward. The comb is colored in various shades of brown and reddish-brown, giving it a mottled, slightly textured appearance. The rectangular top portion is thicker and darker, while the tines are thinner and slightly curved. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are a few faint, vertical tan marks to the left of the comb. The composition is centered with the comb positioned in the middle of the paper, and there are no other objects or significant details present in the drawing.
